The following events took place in '''533 BBY'''.

==Events==
*[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Gravid]] is slain by his apprentice, [[Darth Gean]], during a [[Duel in Darth Gravid's bastion|duel]] on [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]].<ref name="Gravid date">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}} establishes that [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] 46 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[46 BBY/Legends|46 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Chapter 25 of [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] establishes that Amidala had "only just turned thirteen," [[Darth Gravid]]'s reign "elapsed some five [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] earlier," and that [[Gender/Legends|he]] [[Death/Legends|died]] in that [[Time/Legends|time]], thus placing that chapter in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] and Gravid's death around 533 BBY.</ref> {{Circa}}
